purpose: Discuss labor reform; teach 圧力/延長/行なわ/意義/払っ/あえて/そうすると/いわば

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 労働改革、社会的な圧力が背景にありますね。
lines.en: Labor reform — social pressure is behind it.
lines.style: student framing the context, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 制度の見直しは、何度も延長されました。
lines.en: The system review was extended repeatedly.
lines.style: teacher noting delays, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 専門委員会で議論が行なわれています。
lines.en: Discussion is being conducted at the expert committee.
lines.style: student updating, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 働き方を変える意義は、大きいですね。
lines.en: The significance of changing how we work is great.
lines.style: teacher affirming the stakes, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 私たちも、関心を払っていきたいです。
lines.en: We also want to keep paying attention.
lines.style: student committing, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あえて声を上げる若者も、増えています。
lines.en: More young people are deliberately speaking up too.
lines.style: teacher noting a trend, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうすると、社会が動き出すんですね。
lines.style: student grasping it, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いわば、市民の力が試される時期です。
lines.en: So to speak, it’s a time when citizens’ power is tested.
lines.style: teacher offering a unifying line, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
